options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Logic difficulty
options.doc:
Difficulty of the logic.

- **moki** (or easy): Recommended for beginners, who only played the game casually.
- **gorlek** (or medium): Harder paths that can use sword and hammer as movement options, and damage boosts.
- **kii** (or hard): Hard and precise paths that use energy weapons as movement.
- **unsafe**: Very hard and unverified paths. Warning: some paths are **extremely hard**.
options.doc_html:
Difficulty of the logic.

  • moki (or easy): Recommended for beginners, who only played the game casually.
  • gorlek (or medium): Harder paths that can use sword and hammer as movement options, and damage boosts.
  • kii (or hard): Hard and precise paths that use energy weapons as movement.
  • unsafe: Very hard and unverified paths. Warning: some paths are extremely hard.
options.doc_fr:
Difficulté de la logique.

- **moki** (ou facile): Recommandé pour les débutants, qui n'ont joué le jeu que de façon décontractée.
- **gorlek** (ou moyen): Des chemins plus durs qui peuvent utiliser l'épée et le marteau comme options de mouvement, et les dommages boostent.
- **kii** (ou dur): chemins durs et précis qui utilisent des armes énergétiques comme mouvement.
- **Insécurité**: chemins très durs et non vérifiés. Avertissement : certains chemins sont **extrêmement difficiles**.

options.name: Glitches
options.doc:
Whether the logic includes paths with glitches. The required tricks depend on the logic difficulty.

- **Gorlek**: includes grounded sentry jumps, sentry as a fire source, breaking walls with Shuriken, and removing
  the kill plane in Feeding Grounds.
- **Kii**: glitches are not included in Kii logic yet.
- **Unsafe**: everything else.

options.name: Starting location
options.doc:
Choose the starting location.

- **vanilla**: spawn in Inkwater Marsh.
- Teleporter name: spawn in this teleporter.
  Possible values: marsh, burrows, howlsden, hollow, glades, wellspring, westwoods, eastwoods,
  reach, depths, eastpools, westpools, westwastes, eastwastes, outerruins, innerruins, willow, shriek.
- **random_tp**: Spawn at a random teleporter (there are weights applied internally for this option).
- **random_loc**: Spawn at a random location (usually placed on a checkpoint).

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Set conditions for entering the final boss. Use the rando wheel (with **V**) to check goal progress.

- **trees**: All trees must be collected.
- **wisps**: All wisps must be collected.
- **quests**: All quests have to be finished.
- **relics**: Place relics in some areas, all of them must be collected.
- **one_random**: Choose one goal at random among the other selected ones.
  e.g. ['one_random', 'trees', 'wisps'] will give trees or wisps.
  If only one_random is selected, it will choose among all goals.

options.name: Randomize Doors
options.doc:
Randomize entrances between the doors.

- **disabled** (or false): no randomization.
- **coupled** (or enabled or true): randomize doors 2 by 2 (going back will put you where you entered the door).
- **decoupled**: the entrances are fully shuffled for both entering and exiting a door.

- **demi bosses**: Demi Bosses like Howl, Beetle and Rock boss start as defeated
- **bosses**: Bosses like Kwolok, Mora and Shriek's combat phases are skipped

options.doc:

For example, item with 'map' in their name will have a map icon.
If no keyword fit, then the icon fall back to Classification.

Par exemple, l'élément avec 'map' dans leur nom aura une icône de carte.
Si aucun mot-clé ne correspond, alors l'icône revient à Classification.

options.name: UT Glitched Configuration
options.doc:
Configuration for Universal Tracker glitched logic. This doesn't affect generation.

- **one_level**: Add the next logic level.
- **glitch**: Add glitches from the current logic level (and one above if `one_level` is also used).
- **free_region**: Remove requirements on max health and Regenerate for entering an area.
- **free_tp**: Remove skills requirements on some teleporters (same effect as `free_teleporters`).
- **max_logic**: Set the logic to unsafe + unpopular + glitches and remove region/tp requirements.
options.doc_fr:
Configuration pour la logique de glissade du traqueur universel. Cela n'affecte pas la génération.

- **un niveau**: Ajoutez le niveau logique suivant.
- **glitch**: Ajouter des points à partir du niveau logique actuel (et un au-dessus si `one_level` est également utilisé).
- **région libre**: Supprimer les exigences sur la santé maximale et Régénérer pour entrer dans une zone.
- **free tp**: Supprimer les exigences de compétences sur certains téléporteurs (même effet que `free_teleporters`).
- **max logical**: Réglez la logique à des points dangereux + impopulaires + et supprimez les exigences de la région/tp.
